Activity.title: Activity
Activity.description: What the engine is working on right now — one human-readable status line.

detail.description: Fine-grained position within the subject, e.g. `chunk 3/17` or `pair 210/1120`.

model.description: Model slug serving this work (the embedder, the scout, or the judge's embedder).

subject.description: The thing being worked on — a CV file name, or `a.pdf vs b.pdf`.

AdSource.title: AdSource
AdSource.description: What backs the ad slot of a candidate's total.

oneOf.description: The judge's pairwise win-rate. It replaces the ad slot's *value* and never its weight, so it changes no row's max-points.

AppPreferences.title: AppPreferences
AppPreferences.description: Application preferences that persist to disk.

color_theme.description: Color scheme (palette) applied on top of light/dark mode: "default", "slate", "ocean", "forest", "amber", or "contrast"

cv_dir_root.description: Root folder for new jobs' default CV directories (`<root>/job-N/cv`), set from Settings → General → CV directory. If None, serve falls back to `gui_cv_dir_root` from `triq.yaml`, then the platform Documents dir + `jobs`.

embedding_model.description: Selected embedding model (e.g. "nomic-embed-text-v1.5"). If None, falls back to the runtime default or the TRIQI_EMBED_MODEL env var.

engine_backend.description: Engine backend preference: "auto" | "ort" | "mlx". Only set by advanced users; if None, uses the config `engine.backend` ("auto" by default).

engine_embed_batch.description: Embed batch size ceiling. If None, uses config (derived from budget).

engine_exec_provider.description: ONNX execution provider: "auto" | "cpu" | "coreml" | etc. If None, uses the config `engine.exec_provider` (None = CPU).

engine_inter_threads.description: Inter-op thread cap. If None, uses config (single-threaded by default).

engine_intra_threads.description: Intra-op thread cap. If None, uses config (derived from libsyscap budget).

engine_max_cores.description: Max cores cap. If None, uses config (no cap).

engine_no_cache.description: Benchmark mode: skip caches. If None, uses config (default false).

gui_idle_unload_secs.description: Idle-unload timeout for the embedding engine in seconds (0 = disable idle unload).

inference_model.description: Selected text-inference model. If None, falls back to the runtime default.

language.description: User's preferred language (e.g., "en", "es", "de") If None, uses system locale detection

quick_pane_shortcut.description: Global shortcut for quick pane (e.g., "CommandOrControl+Shift+.") If None, uses the default shortcut

BundleExportOptions.title: BundleExportOptions
BundleExportOptions.description: What to include in an export.

criterion_ids.description: Ids of the criteria to include (order preserved).

top_n.description: Export only the top N ranked candidates (CV files + result rows); `None` = all. Unranked candidates sort last and are dropped first.

BundleExportSummary.title: BundleExportSummary
BundleExportSummary.description: Outcome of an export (surfaced as a toast / log).

Candidate.title: Candidate
Candidate.description: One applicant's CV within a Job.

liked.description: Whether the user has starred this CV (feedback signal).

points.description: Total rubric points. None until ranked.

points_max.description: Sum of question max-points (the rubric capacity). None until ranked.

rubric_scores.description: Per-question rubric breakdown. Empty until ranked.

viewed_at.description: When the user last opened this CV in the inspector (read/unread marking; NULL = unread).

CandidateNeighbors.title: CandidateNeighbors
CandidateNeighbors.description: Prev/next candidate ids in the job's global ordering (for overlay navigation across all candidates, not just the triqui).

CandidatePage.title: CandidatePage
CandidatePage.description: A page of candidate results for the browser.

CandidateSummary.description: One row in the candidate browser (all of a job's candidates, not just the ranked triqui). Carries the per-question breakdown for the spreadsheet columns.

ad_source.description: What backs the ad slot of this candidate's total.

grade_space.description: Which embedding space this candidate's criteria/feedback similarities come from. `None` until something has graded it at all.

liked.description: Whether the user has liked this CV (feedback signal).

points.description: Total rubric points. None until ranked.

points_max.description: Sum of question max-points (the rubric capacity). None until ranked.

scores.description: Per-question points (one row per rubric question). Empty until ranked.

viewed_at.description: When the user last opened this CV in the inspector (read/unread marking; NULL = unread).

ChunkExplanation.title: ChunkExplanation
ChunkExplanation.description: One chunk that contributed to a rubric score via maxsim.

similarity.description: Cosine similarity of this chunk against the question vector.

text.description: The chunk text from the CV.

ChunkMatchResult.title: ChunkMatchResult
ChunkMatchResult.description: Match Lens response: EVERY chunk of the candidate at the requested size, in document order. The frontend picks the top-n and ranks, so changing n re-ranks client-side without a refetch.

model.description: Model slug that produced the vectors.

ChunkMatchTarget.title: ChunkMatchTarget
ChunkMatchTarget.description: Which text the CV chunks are compared against in the Match Lens (CV Inspector). Serialized externally tagged: `"JobAd"`, `{"Criterion": {"id": "..."}}`.

ChunkSim.description: One CV chunk with its char range in the extracted text and its cosine similarity to the target.

char_end.description: Char index one past the chunk end.

char_start.description: Char index of the chunk start in the candidate's extracted text.

similarity.description: Cosine similarity of the chunk embedding against the target embedding.

CosinePair.title: CosinePair
CosinePair.description: Result of a single pair-wise cosine comparison.

Criterion.title: Criterion
Criterion.description: An extra requirement beyond the job ad (always positive — negative criteria removed).

DomainError.title: DomainError
DomainError.description: Fallible-domain errors (typed for frontend matching via `#[serde(tag = "type")]`).

EmbedderVariants.title: EmbedderVariants
EmbedderVariants.description: Which arm serves an embedder slug on this machine, and whether its weights are on disk — resolved engine-free (no model load, no wrapper).

mlx_present.description: The MLX variant exists (`None` when the model declares no variant).

onnx_present.description: The ONNX graph exists (the arm-independent fallback).

present.description: The effective arm's weights exist on disk.

runtime.description: `"ort"` or `"mlx"` — the arm `embed` would be served by.

GradeSpace.title: GradeSpace
GradeSpace.description: Which embedding space a candidate's *criteria and feedback* similarities were computed in (scoring v3).

oneOf.description: The cheap scout's space — the candidate has not been reached by the heavy embedder yet. Every candidate has a complete scorecard here, because the scout scores the whole rubric rather than only the ad.

GuiEmbedder.title: GuiEmbedder
GuiEmbedder.description: One ONNX embedder from `triq.yaml` `gui_embedders`, enriched with on-disk state.

downloaded.description: True when the ONNX files are present in the model cache.

is_default.description: True when this is the active default embedder (per saved preferences).

name.description: Human-readable name shown in the UI.

size_bytes.description: On-disk size of the cached model, in bytes (0 when not downloaded).

slug.description: Model slug (also the cache directory name), e.g. `nomic-embed-text-v1.5`.

Job.description: A single hiring opening the HR user is screening for.

ad_weight.description: Rubric weight: max points for the job-ad question.

fb_job_weight.description: Rubric weight: max points for the per-job feedback question.

fb_profile_weight.description: Rubric weight: max points for the cross-job feedback question.

inputs_updated_at.description: When ranking inputs (ad / N / criteria) last changed. Drives the stale badge (NOT bumped on a mere title edit).

job_ad_path.description: The job-ad **file** this job reads its ad from, absolute. Resolved on first read to `<cv-root>/<job-slug>/job-ad.txt` and created empty; the user can point it elsewhere ("Change"). The ad itself lives in that file — this app has no ad editor — and edits on disk are picked up and re-ranked. `None` only until it has been resolved once.

JobAdFile.title: JobAdFile
JobAdFile.description: The job-ad **file**: where it is and what it says.

created.description: True when this call had to create the file.

path.description: Absolute path to the ad file. Created empty on first resolution.

text.description: The file's contents; empty when the user has not written an ad yet.

rubric.description: The results-table columns, in display order: the cascade's stage grades in pipeline order (lexical, scout, the job-ad cosine the heavy embedder gives, the judge's win-rate), then the rubric the total is made of (criteria and the two feedback rows).

rubric_capacity.description: Σ |max_points| over the questions that count towards `points` — the rubric's whole weight. Backend-derived so the sheet never has to re-decide which columns are rubric and which are stages.

JobSummary.title: JobSummary
JobSummary.description: One row in the Jobs list — precomputed facts (no status enum).

JobUiState.title: JobUiState
JobUiState.description: Backend-owned enablement state for a job's Re-rank button.

engine_ready.description: Engine status is `Running` (a rank may need it for re-embedding).

rank.description: Progressive-ranking cascade state (live run + last-rank coverage).

reason.description: Stable reason code for the current state, precedence: `no-cvs` > `no-jobad` > `engine-not-ready` > `stale` > `clean`.

rerank_dirty.description: Ranking inputs changed since the last rank (or never ranked).

sort_allowed.description: At least one extracted CV — without it ranking is meaningless.

LicenseStatus.title: LicenseStatus
LicenseStatus.description: License status for the judge license.

ModelDownloadComplete.title: ModelDownloadComplete
ModelDownloadComplete.description: Completion payload emitted when an ONNX model download finishes.

ModelDownloadProgress.title: ModelDownloadProgress
ModelDownloadProgress.description: Progress payload emitted during an ONNX model download.

ModelKind.title: ModelKind
ModelKind.description: Which kind of model an operation targets.

QuestionKind.title: QuestionKind
QuestionKind.description: Which kind of rubric question a row represents.

oneOf.description: "Job fit (judge)" — pairwise-judge win-rate replacing the `Ad` cosine row when the gui judge stage is active (`gui_judge_artifact`).

Stage-0.5 scout row — the cheap multilingual embedder's similarity to the job ad, in the ad row's currency. Scored for *every* candidate, so the results table can show what the scout thought of a CV that the heavy embedder has not reached yet.

RankProgress.title: RankProgress
RankProgress.description: Progress event payload for a running cascade (`rank-progress` event).

reason.description: Stable reason code while the run is alive but not making progress: `holding` = the system-capacity budget says hold (low memory).

RankState.title: RankState
RankState.description: Backend-derived state of a job's progressive-ranking cascade.

converged.description: The last completed rank covers every candidate and inputs are clean.

embedded_done.description: Candidates embedded with the current model so far.

embedded_total.description: Candidates with embeddable text — the embed stage's total.

judged.description: Candidates in the judge pool so far.

ranking.description: The active cascade is actually ranking this job.

reason.description: Stable reason code for the cascade state, precedence: `running` > `cancelled` > `stale` > `converged` > `partial`.

running.description: A cascade run is active for this job right now.

stage.description: Live stage of the active run: `lex` | `embed` | `sort`.

wave.description: Current wave number (1-based) while running waves.

RecoveryError.title: RecoveryError
RecoveryError.description: Error types for recovery operations (typed for frontend matching)

oneOf.description: File does not exist (expected case, not a failure)

protocol_version.description: Protocol version sent by the client (e.g., "1.2.0"). The server uses this to verify compatibility.

ResultsCsvSummary.title: ResultsCsvSummary
ResultsCsvSummary.description: Outcome of a results CSV export (surfaced as a toast).

RubricQuestion.title: RubricQuestion
RubricQuestion.description: One question in a job's rubric (the scoring model) — no per-candidate value.

RubricScore.title: RubricScore
RubricScore.description: One row of a candidate's rubric score: points earned on a single question.

chunk_explanations.description: Top matching CV chunk texts with similarity scores (maxsim explanation).

RuntimeStatusInfo.title: RuntimeStatusInfo
RuntimeStatusInfo.description: Snapshot of the modelcaller engine state for the UI.

activity.description: What the engine is working on right now, when it is.

backend.description: The arm serving `model` as its load response reported it: `"ort"` or `"mlx"`. `None` until the first load.

busy.description: An embed is currently in flight (only meaningful while `Running`).

dim.description: Vector dimension; `0` until the first embedding response.

SortReport.title: SortReport
SortReport.description: Read-model of the last rank of a job: what the judge stage actually did.

cancelled.description: The last rank was cancelled mid-run (partial coverage).

complete.description: The last rank covered every candidate (not cancelled mid-run).

mode.description: How the last rank ran: `full` (one blocking pass) or `waves` (progressive cascade).

waves.description: Waves completed by the last rank (0 for full passes).

SystemBudget.title: SystemBudget
SystemBudget.description: Backend-derived snapshot of the system-capacity budget (libsyscap).

embed_batch.description: Effective embed batch cap (`None` = config sets none).

load.description: The load sample the verdict was computed from.

thread_cap.description: Effective intra-op thread cap the budget hands out.

on_battery.description: `None` when the host has no readable battery.

TriqiItem.description: A ranked triqui row (no extracted text — fetched on overlay open).

liked.description: Whether the user has liked this CV (feedback signal).

points.description: Total rubric points. None until ranked.

points_max.description: Sum of question max-points (the rubric capacity). None until ranked.

viewed_at.description: When the user last opened this CV in the inspector (read/unread marking; NULL = unread).

labels.description: CV labels (short descriptions for the matrix).

median_ms.description: Median processing time per CV in milliseconds.

pairs.description: All pair-wise cosine similarities (45 pairs for 10 CVs).

per_cv_ms.description: Per-CV processing times in milliseconds (one per CV).
